text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — launching a limited trial called 'minute-smoothing' plus an automated onboarding credit for small accounts. Details below.
Alex: TL;DR: 1) 5-minute rolling smoothing applied at the billing aggregation layer to reduce invoice volatility. 2) One-time 'stabilization credit' (auto-applied) for accounts with avg monthly spend < $500 during first 48h. 3) Temporary soft-overage window: soft cap at 2x committed tier for first 7 days before hard throttle. Pilot customers only.
Alex: Rollout plan: pilot -> 50 customers today, extended pilot next week, GA ~3 weeks pending metrics.
Maria: Nice. How does this interact with realtime rate limits? We had token spikes in EU yesterday.
Jared: No changes to runtime per-sec rate limits. This is purely an aggregation/billing-layer smoothing. Runtime SLOs and rate limiter behavior remain identical.
Lena: For Support/ops: auto-credit will set metadata flag `auto_stab_credit=true` on eligible accounts at signup.
Maria: Can customers opt out? Some enterprise customers prefer raw, unadjusted invoices.
Alex: Yes — opt-out via account settings or by opening a ticket. We will support `suppress_auto_credit` flag.
FinBot: billing-service deploy scheduled: `deploy/billing/2026-03-23/rollout-1` — migration script will run at 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Expect brief DB connection spikes.
Jared: Migration notes: backfill of per-minute buckets for the previous 48h will run for pilot customers. Backfill can be disabled per-customer if needed.
Lena: Legal: need a short clause in the pilot docs/TOS about discretionary credits.
Maria: Looping in @Legal.
Legal: Quick read — pilot ok. Include the clause: "Stabilization credits are granted at the company's sole discretion and may be revoked or adjusted."
Support: Preparing playbook and canned responses for customers who notice invoice adjustments.
Alex: Action items: 1) Eng — monitor cost delta and error rates during pilot (Jared). 2) Finance — confirm GL mapping and tax treatment for stabilization credits (Maria). 3) Support — publish help doc and escalation flow (Lena). 4) PM — notify top 20 customers via targeted email (Alex).
Maria: I'll draft the outbound email and share by EOD.
Jared: I'll build dashboards: `billing.minute_smooth_delta` and `invoices.auto_credit_count` and wire alerts if variance > 5%.
Support: Note — a small list of pilot customers are pre-flagged `no_auto_credit`; we'll honor that.
Alex: Will post a short follow-up after the deploy. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Billing-bot: INFO: Migration started at 2026-03-23T18:00:12Z for rollout-1 (2758126520)
Alex: Confirmed migration finished with no incidents. Pilot live for 50 accounts. Reverted backfill for 3 accounts due to anomalous token spikes.
Maria: Early numbers look good — invoice variance <1% vs baseline for pilot cohort. Small cost smoothing win :tada:
Jared: Dashboards & logs: https://console.redwood/billing/dashboards/minute-smooth and https://logs.redwood/billing/2758123456
Support: Help doc draft: https://docs.redwood/support/minute-smoothing.md — ready for review.
Alex: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if anything regresses.
